column7: '1295418670']	China and the Netherlands seek ‘pragmatic’ reset as Nexperia row rolls on	"The phone call between the Dutch and Chinese foreign ministers was a first on a series of fronts.

column1: For the new Dutch Foreign Minister Tom Berendsen
column2: the call on March 13 was his first with his Chinese counterpart Wang Yi since taking on the job a few weeks earlier.

column1: It was also the first between the two holders of the offices since China and the Netherlands became embroiled in a row over the control of Chinese-owned
Nexperia is a major component in the electric vehicle supply chain and wholly owned by Wingtech Technology
column2: a company that the United States has blacklisted in its growing technological rivalry with China.
Dutch authorities seized control of Nexperia’s management and ousted its Chinese CEO
column3: Zhang Xuezheng – who is also Wingtech’s founder – to prevent what it said was the transfer of technology from Nexperia to China.

column1: The move upended supply chains around the world and led to a series of swift countermeasures by Beijing.
The row has yet to be resolved but in the call with Berendsen in mid-March
column2: Wang said China appreciated the “positive signals”."	2026-03-21 17:50:29+08:00	Success
